## 2. Rulings on key claims

- GCC.1 and S_a = 3aN_a: **PROVED** (branch proof + three independent verifications; my direct sums extend numeric confirmation to p=19 both classes).
- Certificate structure: **PROVED** — sufficiency unconditional; failure modes exactly N_a ∈ {0} ∪ 2pZ_{>0} (parity protection); certificate list complete at length two (C_3, C_1, all other cofactors identically 0 on the depressed slice); moment battery lossless; only the (0,0) count moment is parity-protected. Ruling on the one apparent inter-agent disagreement: the Cartier agent's "C_1 is a working backup" and the missed-sweep's "C_1 heuristically doomed" are compatible (finite data range vs asymptotic heuristic); the missed-sweep framing is correct — C_1 should not be promoted.

- E_1 = ±p occurs (zero irreducible fibers at (7;q=1,6), (11;q=3,6)): **PROVED** (my counts confirm) — pointwise Weil at j=1 cannot give the crown; the content is in the q-average and the two ε-readings.

## 3. State of the d=1 crown after this round

Proved: crown for all p < 1200; the exact certificate equivalence (crown at p, class a ⇔ N_a ∉ {0} ∪ 2pZ; S_a ≢ 0 mod p suffices); the complete structural theory of the certificate (cofactor theorem, trinomial H-formula, survivor law, two-class structure from the matrix side); the disc-mass exactness (parity sieves structurally blind); the full unconditional ledger with verified wild inertia; and — new this round — at p=5 the complete, proved identification of the post-cancellation surviving object as [one Kummer class] ⊕ [H¹ of two explicit curves], with an exact prime-number-theorem-style count formula per q.

The picture DID change, in two ways. (i) Route A matured from "a certificate exists" to a finished structural theory with exactly one unproved statement left (the support/cancellation law) and a proof that nothing cheaper exists (no third certificate, no closed form in the tested motive classes, no coupling, no correlation). (ii) Route B's door genuinely opened: the 2^{p-1}-dimensional bookkeeping empirically collapses to a rank ≈ 4p object made of explicit, identified curves, proved at p=5, strongly supported at p=7/11. Honest caveat on route B's endgame: even granting the collapse, naive Weil II on the q-line families gives Σ_q E_1 = O(dim·p) with dim = O(p), which only yields N_a = p + O(p) — the crown then needs the algebraic/Tate part of the surface H² computed exactly (those give exact multiples of p) with a transcendental remainder of dimension o(p) or with an explicit constant < 1. This constant battle is unexamined and is the real test of route B.

Sharpest surviving open statement: **for every p ≥ 5 there is a class a with N_a(p) ∉ {0, 2p, 4p, ...}** — equivalently Σ_{c,d}C_3(F_{a,c,d}) ≢ 0 mod p — equivalently the q-averaged trace Σ_{cells} E_1 stays below p(p−1) for one class.

## 4. Ranked next moves

1. **(Highest EV) q-line assembly with exact surface cohomology at p=5,7,11**: using the identified families B_q, D_q and the Kummer/boundary terms, compute Σ_q E_1(q) per class exactly and decompose the total-space H² into algebraic classes (exact multiples of p, computable) vs transcendental remainder. This directly measures whether route B's constant battle is winnable and converts the door conjecture into an exact finite theorem at three primes. Data already exists; the running census jobs feed it. Must carry the unramified-quadratic-twist caveat in all Frobenius bookkeeping.
2. **Prove the Cartier support/cancellation law** (α+2β ≤ (p+1)/2; weighted degree (p²+2p−9)/2): finite, well-posed exact algebra; the cancellation mechanism it exposes is the same one any evaluation of S_a must use; likely via a pole-order/weight filtration on the differential space. Even a proof of the support law alone would be the first general-p exact theorem about the mod-p sum beyond the certificate identity.
3. **Cheap harvest + weight-0 groundwork**: collect the in-flight p=7 j=8 census and p=13 Ej data (settles V_3/V_4 candidates and pins r(p)~4p); rerun the dead p17_a3 symbolic job if the survivor-decomposition detail is wanted (its sum-level prediction is already confirmed); then attempt the weight-0 cancellation proof for general p (puncture permutation modules and cyclotomic classes are fully combinatorial — no wild subtleties — and the p=5 proof plus p=7 consistency give the template).

**Single decisive lemma to attempt** (feeds both routes and is the tractable end of the parity-pairing wall): *Weight-0 collapse lemma — for every p ≥ 5 and q ∉ {0,2}, after even/odd semisimplification all weight-0 Frobenius constituents of ⊕_i H¹_c(U, V_i) cancel except the single Kummer class χ(u_q(t²−1)).* It is proved at p=5, consistent at p=7, purely combinatorial (puncture modules + tame data), and its proof mechanism — an explicit parity-reversing correspondence on puncture modules — is the prototype the weight-1 sector needs. Success would be the first general-p slice of the collapse; failure would locate exactly where the no-go stack bites.

Closed: Wall B ledger (independently re-derived, branch script and JSON reproduced row-for-row); WII.1/WII.2 wild inertia (two independent local-field routes); tame transpositions; Λ_p conductor identities; validation table (three independent recomputations now agree, p ≤ 131 plus my 101/127 spot checks); GCC.1 including necessity of the X^p−s exclusion; disc-mass closed form; odd-cubic classification; certificate completeness.
